item.title: Mihama Fireworks Festival: A Summer Fireworks Display Over Wakasa Bay — Guide
item.description: The Mihama Fireworks Festival is held each summer along the scenic Wakasa Bay coast in southern Fukui, lighting up the night sky over the water in one of the region’s most anticipated seasonal events. The setting over the bay allows the fireworks to reflect across the water’s surface, and the beachside location draws crowds who gather along the coast to watch the display, often combined with food stalls and a festive summer evening atmosphere in the surrounding area.
